baseline_construction_cases.text: Human approval is required for all automated payment refund executions.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Exact match for 'human approval'

baseline_construction_cases.text: Security incident response plans must be tested systematically at least annually.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Exact match for 'incident response'

baseline_construction_cases.text: Independent review and audit of model validation must be conducted by internal audit.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Exact match for 'independent review'

baseline_construction_cases.text: All customer dispute complaint handling must adhere to internal dispute resolution procedures.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Exact match for 'dispute resolution'

baseline_construction_cases.text: Third-party service provider contracts must specify business continuity and exit strategies.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Exact match for 'third-party' and 'due diligence'

baseline_construction_cases.text: Manual sign-off and four-eyes authorization is mandatory prior to releasing batch disbursements.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Banking terminology 'four-eyes authorization' and 'manual sign-off' instead of 'human approval'

baseline_construction_cases.text: Statistical parity across demographic sub-populations must be evaluated during credit scorecard calibration.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Data science term 'statistical parity across demographic sub-populations' instead of 'bias testing'

baseline_construction_cases.text: Cryptographic material must reside exclusively inside FIPS 140-3 Level 3 hardware security modules with dual custody.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Technical standard 'FIPS 140-3 HSM with dual custody' instead of generic 'encryption'

baseline_construction_cases.text: Data subject rectification and erasure requests must be fulfilled within 30 calendar days.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Privacy term 'Data subject rectification and erasure' instead of 'access and correction'

baseline_construction_cases.text: Counterparty insolvency contingencies and operational substitution protocols must be documented for cloud infrastructure.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: CPS 230 term 'operational substitution protocols' instead of 'vendor exit strategy'

baseline_construction_cases.text: Under no circumstances shall human approval be bypassed or omitted for automated credit limits.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Affirmative control expressed as a prohibition of bypass

baseline_construction_cases.text: This standalone sandbox environment does not require human approval or multi-factor authentication.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Explicit negative exemption: control does NOT apply. Substring matcher might falsely trigger on 'human approval'

baseline_construction_cases.text: Staff are prohibited from conducting ad-hoc bias testing using production customer PII.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Prohibition of using PII in testing; keyword 'bias testing' should not be interpreted as satisfying model validation

baseline_construction_cases.text: The team should maintain documentation of models where practicable.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Non-mandatory ('should', 'where practicable') aspirational statement, lacks mandatory binding force

baseline_construction_cases.text: Logging is enabled on the web tier.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Generic log mention; does NOT satisfy 7-year immutable audit trail under APRA CPS 234

baseline_construction_cases.text: Third-party models are reviewed informally during vendor selection.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Informal review does not meet formal CPS 230 material service provider due diligence

baseline_construction_cases.text: All automated customer refunds exceeding AUD 1,000 require senior manager approval.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Threshold 1000 AUD

baseline_construction_cases.text: All automated dispute payments above AUD 250 must be escalated for branch manager sign-off.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Threshold 250 AUD (conflicts with 1000 AUD in BASE-17)

baseline_construction_cases.text: In the event of Severity 1 core banking downtime, human approval thresholds are temporarily raised to AUD 5,000 for verified essential services.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Disaster recovery conditional exception

baseline_construction_cases.text: Model bias audits are exempt for heuristic rule-based systems processing fewer than 100 applications per month.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: De minimis exemption condition

baseline_construction_cases.text: Customer personal data retention must not exceed 7 years post account closure.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Policy A retention rule

baseline_construction_cases.text: Under APP 11, customer records and transaction telemetry must be permanently deleted after 7 years.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Policy B duplicate of BASE-21 with slight phrasing difference

baseline_construction_cases.text: All generative AI prompts and completions must be logged to write-once WORM storage with a 10-year retention horizon and cryptographic hash-chaining.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Exceeds standard 7-year CPS 234 requirement with 10-year WORM storage

baseline_construction_cases.text: Indigenous data sovereignty protocols and consultation with First Nations community representatives must precede training on regional acoustic dialect datasets.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Specific cultural governance requirement not covered in standard 33 controls

baseline_construction_cases.text: Legacy Credit Policy 2021: Machine learning algorithms may deploy with single-tier manager sign-off.
baseline_construction_cases.notes: Superseded 2021 policy version conflicting with 2026 multi-tier approval policy

strategy_assessment_cases.name: Clear Board AI Governance
strategy_assessment_cases.text: The Board Risk Committee retains ultimate accountability for enterprise AI adoption and reviews high-risk AI inventory semi-annually.

strategy_assessment_cases.name: Vague Ethical Aspiration
strategy_assessment_cases.text: We believe in ethical, responsible AI and aim to do the right thing for all our valued customers.

strategy_assessment_cases.name: Missing Human Oversight
strategy_assessment_cases.text: Autonomous credit decisioning will scale unconstrained across digital channels to optimize operational throughput.

strategy_assessment_cases.name: Formal Algorithm Validation Cadence
strategy_assessment_cases.text: All quantitative AI models undergo independent technical validation by Model Risk Management prior to deployment and annually thereafter.

strategy_assessment_cases.name: Aspirational Fairness Consideration
strategy_assessment_cases.text: Where practicable, project teams are encouraged to think about fairness when selecting training sets.

strategy_assessment_cases.name: Strict Model Explainability Mandate
strategy_assessment_cases.text: Adverse credit decisions generated or assisted by AI must produce legally compliant reasons for decision under NCCP Act and ASIC guidance.

strategy_assessment_cases.name: Missing Third-Party Model Governance
strategy_assessment_cases.text: Third-party commercial cloud AI APIs are consumed as standard SaaS utilities under standard terms.
strategy_assessment_cases.reason: Fails APRA CPS 230 third-party material risk governance

strategy_assessment_cases.name: Comprehensive CPS 230 Vendor AI Due Diligence
strategy_assessment_cases.text: Material AI service providers must undergo formal operational risk review, fourth-party subcontracting assessment, and contractual audit-rights verification.

strategy_assessment_cases.name: Uncommitted Cybersecurity Strategy
strategy_assessment_cases.text: AI security is an important emerging topic which IT operations intends to address in future roadmaps.

strategy_assessment_cases.name: Binding Cyber Testing Framework
strategy_assessment_cases.text: Annual red-teaming, prompt injection resilience testing, and external cryptographic assessment are mandatory for public-facing LLMs.

strategy_assessment_cases.name: Missing Privacy Governance Structure
strategy_assessment_cases.text: Teams are advised to consult general privacy policies available on the intranet.
strategy_assessment_cases.reason: No formal Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) mandate

strategy_assessment_cases.name: Mandatory Privacy Impact Assessment
strategy_assessment_cases.text: A formal Privacy Impact Assessment signed by the Data Protection Officer is mandatory prior to processing personal data in AI models.

Have you considered ethical implications?
questionnaire_assessment_cases.notes: Vague open-ended topic mention without evaluative criteria

questionnaire_assessment_cases.question: What is the exact maximum dollar threshold permitted before automated transaction approval must halt for human review?
Is your system fast and modern?
Are personal data elements masked in prompt logs sent to third-party model providers?
Is independent model validation performed by personnel independent of model developers?
questionnaire_assessment_cases.notes: Tests structural independence under APRA CPS 220

questionnaire_assessment_cases.question: Do you use commercial cloud providers?
questionnaire_assessment_cases.notes: Fact inquiry only, does not evaluate whether due diligence is conducted

questionnaire_assessment_cases.question: Has a formal operational risk and exit strategy assessment been conducted for the AI supplier under CPS 230?
Can the automated system override a human manager's rejection?
questionnaire_assessment_cases.notes: Verifies human supremacy in delegated authority

questionnaire_assessment_cases.question: Tell us about your AI project.
How often are algorithmic bias audits performed across protected attributes?
Is encryption used?
questionnaire_assessment_cases.notes: Incomplete; does not assess cipher strength, key management or transit vs rest

questionnaire_assessment_cases.question: Are customer complaints involving AI decisions triaged within RG 271 maximum timeframes (30 days standard, 21 days financial hardship)?
